family_definition.title: the association between density and vertical velocity

family_definition.finding_goal: Characterize the association between density and vertical velocity

questions.o1_f1: In the supplied Rayleigh–Taylor instability snapshot, consider the complete supplied three-dimensional mesh. Investigate the association between density and vertical velocity. Use all cells, with stored cell values directly and arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields. Measure association by the volume-weighted Pearson correlation. Weight cell statistics by cell volume and normalize by the included volume. Report the numerical association coefficient.
